name: Tide Masjid
summary: A low mosque and a rising minaret are carried by one continuous sweep of water.
why: The water is the foundation of the entire silhouette, with a shared lower outline rather than a separate wave beneath it. The tower grows out of the right wall. A centered doorway remains fully enclosed above the waterline.
risk: At 24px the wave reads as a color band; the broad mosque and tall minaret remain the main identity.
sub1: The added element carries the architecture
sub2: A tapered tower balances the low roof
theme: A mosque held by a flowing tide
reasonToChoose: You want expressive movement and a bold blue identity without a separate decorative symbol.
